summary: Customer A is currently classified as High Risk due to multiple early-warning signals, including a 39% revenue drop, negative cash flow, and 90 days past due on their loan. The situation is further complicated by a related company, An Phat Garment Co., being 65 days past due, indicating potential contagion risk.

findings.statement: Customer A has experienced a 38.6% drop in 90-day revenue compared to the baseline.
The customer has recorded negative net cash flow for two consecutive periods (-1392.1 and -658.1).
Related company An Phat Garment Co. is currently 65 days past due.
Collateral value for the loan has decreased by 9.8% from its peak.
The loan for Customer A has reached 90 days past due.

recommended_actions.rationale: The customer exhibits more than 3 early-warning signals, requiring immediate escalation to High Risk and monthly monitoring per policy P-17.
Due to the related company An Phat Garment Co. being past due, a formal review of contagion risk and repayment capacity is required per policy P-31.

limitations: The officer should verify if the guarantor Guarantor 43 has sufficient liquidity to cover the loan exposure given the deteriorating financial health of the customer and the related party.
